subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
1. 
Whether the view of Mudit regarding obtaining understanding of the 
client business is correct: 
 
(a) 
The view of Mudit is correct because as a member of the audit 
team, he needs an understanding only about the audit procedures 
to be performed by him. 
(b) 
The view of Mudit is not correct because while conducting an 
audit, the understanding of business and business environment of 
the client whose audit is to be conducted is very important. 
(c)  
The view of Mudit is partially correct because such understanding 
is required only for the engagement partner and not be the 
members of the audit team. 
(d)  
The view of Mudit is not correct because such information forms a 
crucial part of the audit report to be issued at the end of the audit 
process. 
 

 
AUDITING AND ETHICS 
 
 
61 
 
MAY 2025 EXAMINATION 
REVISION TEST PAPER
